lines.trans: For arbitrarily manipulating show production and causing a negative impact.
Chun Yuqiao is relieved of his authority as Chief Content Officer of Xingtian.
His salary is also cut by fifty percent, effective today.
Manipulating show production—was this not about that troublesome artist?
Xiaoye, what on earth is going on here?
Could Manta Ray have gotten into this because he stood up for you?
Xingzi, I have looked everywhere and still cannot find Chun Yuqiao.
